entries.title: Half-Life

emulation.notes: Native Windows is primary. PCSX2 only applies to the separate Decay/PS2 route.

primary.why: The 25th Anniversary Steam build is Valve's current supported route for the original Half-Life, with restored bonus content and modern compatibility work. It supports Windows, OS X, and Linux, while the PlayStation 2 port is kept separate from the Decay entry because Decay is cataloged as its own game.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam Windows build of Half-Life. Use the PlayStation 2 version only for comparison, and play Decay through its own entry.

all_releases.fidelity: Current official Steam route with 25th Anniversary updates, restored extras, and modern PC settings.
all_releases.reason: primary: Valve's maintained version is the best fidelity and completeness route for the original game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Half-Life: Source is not the preferred route after the 25th Anniversary update; use it only for Source-engine comparison or mod dependencies.

entries.title: Half-Life: Decay

emulation.notes: Use accurate PS2 emulation with two controllers, or original hardware for authenticity.

primary.version: Half-Life PS2 Decay campaign via PCSX2 or original hardware
primary.why: Decay is documented as a PlayStation 2-exclusive cooperative expansion bundled with the PS2 version of Half-Life. Because no official PC release is sourced, the archive route is PS2 via accurate emulation or original hardware.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally owned PlayStation 2 copy of Half-Life in PCSX2 with two-controller setup, or original PS2 hardware, and play only the Decay campaign.

all_releases.fidelity: Only official sourced release; best capture comes from PCSX2 or clean original hardware capture.
all_releases.reason: primary: exclusive official release platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Decay has only one official sourced platform release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute unofficial PC ports for the primary archive route unless a later official release appears.

primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam Windows build of Half-Life 2. Play the base campaign from the main menu, then use the linked entries for Episode One, Episode Two, and Lost Coast.

all_releases.fidelity: Current 20th Anniversary PC route with updated maps, commentary, Workshop, and bundled episode access.

entries.title: Half-Life: Alyx

emulation.notes: Native PC VR. Headset and GPU choice define the fidelity ceiling.

primary.why: Half-Life: Alyx is Valve's VR Half-Life game for Windows and Linux with support for SteamVR-compatible headsets. Windows PC VR has the broadest headset/GPU capture route and highest practical fidelity ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam Windows build with a high-end SteamVR-compatible headset and GPU. Tune headset resolution, refresh rate, and capture settings before recording.

all_releases.fidelity: Highest PC VR hardware and capture ceiling.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity route with broad headset support.
skip: useful native route, but Windows has the default headset/capture compatibility advantage.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced exclusive content exists outside the Windows VR route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Requires VR hardware; non-VR mods are not the primary route for a first archive playthrough.

entries.title: Black Mesa

primary.why: Black Mesa is a standalone third-party remake of Half-Life, approved for commercial release by Valve and fully released for Windows and Linux. Windows is the highest-fidelity capture route, while the original Half-Life remains its own entry because this is a remake rather than a replacement for preservation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam Windows build as a separate remake playthrough after the original Half-Life route, not as a substitute for the 1998 game.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC remake route with the strongest capture/settings ceiling.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity route for the remake.
skip: no sourced exclusive content over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Black Mesa is a remake with its own altered interpretation; preserve it separately from original Half-Life rather than using it to replace the original.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a remake by Crowbar Collective, not the original Valve game; do not conflate it with the original Half-Life entry.
